item.title: Don’t hire thoughtbot to write code
item.content:encoded: AI makes code faster and cheaper to produce. Premium consultancies need to offer more: experienced judgment, the right capabilities, and people who help teams solve the right problems and make better decisions.

item.title: AI makes creating software faster, but in regulated industries, judgment matters more
item.content:encoded: AI is accelerating software delivery, but regulated industries face a harder challenge: moving faster without increasing risk. Here’s how teams can balance speed with privacy, security, compliance, and accountability.

item.title: PMs Don't Need to Code, but They Do Need to Understand
item.content:encoded: A Product Manager doesn't need to code, but understanding technology can completely change the quality of conversations, decisions, and collaboration with engineering.

item.title: How healthcare tech teams innovate while balancing speed and security
item.content:encoded: Healthcare can be a tough space for innovation: Speed often feels at odds with the high-compliance environment. How do you find a balance? We asked them in a new research study and sat down with a Merck executive and two of our own developers.

item.title: Can’t touch the DOM? Reach for :has() to style any element
item.content:encoded: Third-party component libraries come with restrictions, the :has() CSS pseudo-selector unlocks flexible style options without needing JavaScript.
